title: GST Council scraps tax officers' arrest powers, eases refund rules

These reforms aim to streamline registration, refunds, and input tax credit processes while lowering compliance costs. Additionally, the council will remove officers' powers for arrests under the GST framework. Processing of refunds will be expedited, with a goal to resolve claims within three days.

title: US suspends Microsoft from Green Card programme, here is what the company has to say

Vice President JD Vance accused Microsoft of abusing the H-1B and PERM system to replace laid-off American workers. Microsoft says 80% of its roughly 6,000 H-1B filings last fiscal year were for existing employees, and that it pays H-1B staff the same as others doing comparable work.

title: ‘Krantiveer’ in life, ‘Natsamrat’ on screen: Nana dies at 75

He was known for his powerful performances in both Hindi and Marathi cinema, spanning nearly five decades. Patekar had a notable impact on Indian cinema, often portraying characters that were unpredictable and emotionally complex. He championed various social causes, including rural distress through his NAAM Foundation.

title: ‘Reckless’ use of NSA has made it ordinary: MP HC

The court criticized the reckless invocation of the Act by authorities and highlighted a lack of evidence. It found the brothers had been acquitted in multiple cases where NSA was applied, asserting non-application of mind. The court underscored the need for constitutional safeguards against arbitrary detentions.

title: Mark Zuckerberg's sister Arielle leads double life as techno DJ since 2018

She described DJing as a “side quest,” saying she mostly performs with friends for fun and to spread joy.

This instance illustrates how brilliant bargains can emerge outside of luxury boutiques.

title: AI use ups homework scores, but slashes exam marks: Study
description: World Bank's report reveals that unrestricted use of generative AI may enhance homework scores while diminishing actual learning outcomes. Evidence indicates that students using AI showed improvement in assignments but performed worse in exams over time. Concerns exist regarding students outsourcing their learning process to AI rather than engaging in cognitive effort. However, AI used by teachers to customize instruction shows promising learning gains.
